description: Tests whether an AI agent has actually read AGENTS.md/.ai/INDEX.md and the linked packs, not guessing from a generic Astro-project prior.
instructions: An agent should be able to answer every question below correctly using only AGENTS.md, .ai/INDEX.md, and the packs it routes to — without opening full docs/ files. If it can't, the token-efficiency system has failed its purpose.

questions.question: What is the default component model for new UI in this repo?
questions.expected_answer: Astro components (.astro) by default. React is not installed and requires explicit, per-component approval per docs/adr/react-islands.md.

questions.question: Where do design tokens live, and what happens if a change introduces a hardcoded hex color?
questions.expected_answer: src/styles/tokens.css. A hardcoded hex color (outside legitimate flag-SVG fills) violates the design-tokens decision and should be flagged/fixed.

questions.question: What is the rule about keystatic.config.ts and src/content.config.ts?
questions.expected_answer: They independently define the same content shapes and must be hand-synced on any schema change — there is no automatic sync, and drift has happened before.

questions.question: Is it currently safe to add a raw tag to a new page-level image grid?
questions.expected_answer: No — Astro <Image> is the required pattern, achieved in index.astro and menu.astro. Note the known limitation: images referenced from public/ pass through unprocessed (no compression gain, only correct width/height/decoding).

questions.question: What is the React island policy in one sentence?
questions.expected_answer: Astro + vanilla <script> is the default for all interactivity; React-as-island is allowed only under narrow, explicitly-approved conditions via the adapter pattern, and no React dependency currently exists in this repo.

questions.question: What commands verify a change before it's considered done?
questions.expected_answer: pnpm build at minimum; pnpm test:e2e and pnpm lhci where practical, though both may fail to execute in a sandboxed environment lacking a Chromium binary — report not_run honestly rather than faking a result.

questions.question: What is the Total Blocking Time budget, and why does it matter most for React islands specifically?
questions.expected_answer: TBT < 200ms, error-level (blocks CI). It's the tightest real constraint on adding any client-side JS — a single unnecessarily-hydrated island can consume the whole budget.

questions.question: What accessibility feature must exist on any keyboard-navigable page, and where's the reference implementation for a modal/overlay?
questions.expected_answer: A skip-to-main-content link (present in Base.astro). MobileNavDrawer.astro is the reference pattern for focus-trap/inert/aria-hidden toggling on any future modal.

questions.question: Where do in-progress, backlog, and completed outcome tasks live?
Where do benchmark results live, and what's the actual current state of the benchmark data as of this setup?
questions.expected_answer: benchmarks/{baseline,current,deltas,reports}/. As of this setup, no historical benchmark data exists — structure is created, values are 'pending', not invented.

questions.question: Does this site have a contact form, user accounts, or a shopping cart?
questions.expected_answer: No to all three — verified via repo-wide search. The only conversion flow hands off externally to Lieferando.

questions.question: Why does CLAUDE.md look different from the large system-prompt content it had earlier this session?
questions.expected_answer: CLAUDE.md was intentionally shrunk to a pointer to AGENTS.md/.ai/INDEX.md per the Agent-Native Repo OS setup; the full prior content was relocated (not deleted) to .ai/packs/outcome-operator.okf.md — see .ai/decisions/agent-entrypoint-reconciliation.okf.md.
